(2) THE CONTRACT HAS AN EMPTY ACCEPT REGION, confirmed at source. spec.json decision_rule.acceptance_criterion requires invariance_leg (perm_p > 0.01, the statistic must be INSENSITIVE to within-stratum permutation of the treatment) and displacement_leg (displacement > MDD, the statistic must be SENSITIVE to the treatment), with both_legs_required=true and precedence_order [MEASUREMENT_INVALID, ACCEPT, REJECT]. prereg.md section 9.1 step 6 freezes exactly the insensitive reading. The two legs are mutually exclusive for any estimator that reads its treatment, and contract_results.json shows all seven cases failing exactly one leg, so IVC_N_ESTIMATORS_ACCEPTED=0 was determined before execution. This is the second consecutive physics packet on C-MEAS-VALID to fail for this reason: parent EXP-PHYSICS-36287170603 identified it and this director_mandate ordered its correction, but the correction was not made. The mandate's own prescription was a within-stratum DYNAMIC-RANGE check plus displacement, and spec.measurement_validity[1] still says dynamic-range; DESIGN substituted a permutation-invariance leg in decision_rule, which is where the contradiction was introduced. (3) A NEW, REUSABLE, BOUNDED NEGATIVE the audit did not reach: the mandated matched-null re-draw is COUNT-PRESERVING, so the displacement leg has provably zero power against label-only readers. The mandate's purpose was to detect estimators that read only the treatment label, and a within-stratum relabel cannot detect a label-reader, because the label's within-stratum multiset is unchanged. The three floating-point-zero deltas (4.44e-16, 1.11e-16, 1.11e-16) are this fact, not noise. This kills an entire family of certification gates, not one criterion, and it is the most transferable thing the packet produced. (4) THE AUDIT IS RIGHT ON DISPOSITION, INCOMPLETE ON INSTRUMENTATION. Confirmed: required_fixes[0] (contradictory criterion), [2] (positive control is not the Codex artifact), [3] (normal approximation instead of matched-null re-draws), [4] (10 permutations per stratum against a preregistered 1000, execute:748), [5] (single fixed null assignment, execute:579). PC-RUNTIME-HEADER-JACCARD-VALIDATED is an inline Jaccard over response-header VALUES grouped by the assignment label, and the header values it pools include X-Assignment and a body md5 whose body embeds the assignment (execute:598-602, 165-172), so the statistic is label-dependent by construction.
